description: This is a React component file written in TypeScript, defining the UsagePage component that manages and displays various usage statistics for a software project, including spend data, activity metrics, top keys, models, and user info. It incorporates multiple API calls, state management, and UI components.

methods.name: customTooltip
methods.description: Renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart displaying top models' values for a specific date.

methods.name: getTopKeys
methods.description: Processes a dataset to identify and return the top five keys based on spend.

methods.name: isAdminOrAdminViewer
methods.description: Determines if the user role qualifies as admin or admin viewer.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a YYYY-MM-DD string.

methods.name: fillMissingDates
methods.description: Fills in missing dates within a dataset with zeroed data to maintain continuous date ranges.

methods.name: fetchOverallSpend
methods.description: Fetches overall spend logs and processes the data to handle missing dates and calculate total spend.

methods.name: fetchTopKeys
methods.description: Fetches and processes the top API keys.

methods.name: fetchTopModels
methods.description: Fetches and processes the top models based on spend.

methods.name: fetchTeamSpend
methods.description: Fetches team-based spending data and populates relevant state.

methods.name: fetchTopTags
methods.description: Fetches the top tags based on spend.

methods.name: fetchGlobalActivity
methods.description: Fetches global activity metrics and fills in missing daily data.

methods.name: fetchGlobalActivityPerModel
methods.description: Fetches and processes global activity metrics per model with missing data filling.
